features: Optional model checksum verification across Windows and WSL; default on
Optional owned staging cleanup after successful completion; default keep
WSL and local model sources prioritized before remote store; no required archive refill during repair
Local-only automatic GUI inventory; network inventory requested explicitly

limitations: Windows PowerShell 5.1/Forms and actual WSL repair still require physical Windows testing
Windows SMB/CIM alias resolution tested through portable guards and simulations, not a live Windows share
